name: aicmm-tools
description: AiCMM framework tools for agent card lifecycle management

create-card.description: Create a new AiCMM Agent Card with 12-dimension scoring

validate-card.description: Validate card against schema + 7 governance rules

score-card.description: Calculate score breakdown and maturity level

inspect-agent.description: Inspect agent from URL or description, generate template

list-catalog.description: List all agent cards with optional category/score filters

get-dimensions.description: Get dimension definitions, positions, and scoring rubrics

get-agency-levels.description: Get the Agency Qualification ladder (derived 13th dimension, position 12): -2 to +5 classifying agents vs non-agents
